description: An enum declaration names a set of categories once, and a member without a value holds its own name as a string
code:
enum Status: PENDING, PAID, SHIPPED
[Status.PAID, Status["SHIPPED"], Status.REFUNDED]

description: Enum members may take scalar literal values: numbers, negative numbers, strings, booleans and null
code:
enum Level: LOW = 1, HIGH = 10
enum Move: BACK = -1, AHEAD = 1
enum Size: LARGE = "XL", SMALL, NONE = null
enum Flag: ON = true, OFF = false
[Level.HIGH + Move.BACK, Size.LARGE, Size.SMALL, Size.NONE, Flag.ON]

description: The indented form lists one member per line, and an enum with a single member uses it
code:
enum Color:
    RED
    GREEN = "#0f0"
enum Mode:
    AUTO
[Color.RED, Color.GREEN, Mode.AUTO]

description: Class-level rules that compare an attribute with an enum member stay live as instances change
code:
enum Stage: TODO, DOING, DONE
class Task(stage):
    this.stage = stage
$Task.active = $Task.stage == Stage.DOING
task = Task(Stage.TODO)
idle = Task(Stage.DONE)
task.stage = Stage.DOING
[task.active, idle.active, Task.count(t -> t.active)]

description: Declaring an enum again replaces it, and every declaration that reads its members follows
code:
enum Plan: FREE, PRO
choice = Plan.TEAM
enum Plan: FREE, PRO, TEAM
[choice, Plan.PRO]

description: An enum is read-only: assigning, adding or deleting a member raises a TypeError and leaves the enum unchanged
code:
enum Status: OPEN, CLOSED
failures = []
try:
    Status.OPEN = "X"
catch error:
    failures.push(error)
try:
    delete Status.CLOSED
catch error:
    failures.push(error)
[failures, Status]

description: A spread copies an enum's members into an ordinary object, and an entry loop visits them in declaration order
enum followed by a single name keeps its accepted meaning, the name enum and a typed declaration, so a single member uses the indented form
code:
enum = 4
try:
    enum Unit: ONLY
catch error:
    failure = error
enum Unit:
    ONLY
[enum * 2, failure, Unit.ONLY]
